justification: B's TryImport puts each drop reason in its own guard-clause if-block in rule order with [NotNullWhen] out contracts, so every failure cause is visible right at the branch site and absence cases (IsNullOrWhiteSpace, priceText?.Trim(), Count == 0 ternary) read inline. A scatters its reasons across Bind/Ensure/ToResult combinators, re-threads tuples through nested lambdas, and mutates captured lists inside Match continuations, so the same rules take real decoding despite excellent comments.
